issue.title: tools/AGENTS.md ToolRun smokes paragraph still says phase-pending; the harness labels skipped live cases not-run
issue.description:
The "ToolRun smokes" section of `tools/AGENTS.md` (and its hardlinked `CLAUDE.md` / `GEMINI.md` / `OPENCODE.md` / `QWEN.md` shims) ends with:

> Later-phase live owner cases remain labeled phase-pending unless `--live` is passed.

That sentence was written by epic commit `91b67672b4` (phase 3) when the harness really did label later-phase cases `phase-pending`. Phase 7 rewrote the harness: it now labels the three live cases `not-run` when `--live` is absent, and it covers every DoD case.

Verified by the sase-135 land agent at master `9a56fc1294`:

- `tools/smoke_sase_tool_runs --sase .venv/bin/sase` -> `failed=0 not-run=3`, with `dod-8-live-monitor: not-run`, `dod-8-live-proc: not-run`, `dod-13-overhead: not-run`. No case is ever labeled `phase-pending`.
- `tools/smoke_sase_tool_runs --sase .venv/bin/sase --live` -> 35/35 pass, `failed=0 not-run=0`, all of DoD-1 through DoD-13 `pass`.

An agent reading the current wording looks for a `phase-pending` label the harness no longer emits, and may read it as leftover epic work rather than a deliberate opt-in for the three cases that need a live monitor, a live proc, and a timing measurement.

Proposed change: replace "remain labeled phase-pending" with "are labeled `not-run`", and say that `--live` runs them (there are three: `dod-8-live-monitor`, `dod-8-live-proc`, `dod-13-overhead`).

Proposed by phase bead sase-135.7 (epic sase-135) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note, which recorded that this edit needs explicit user approval through `/sase_memory_write`; filed by the sase-135 land agent on 2026-09-20 rather than edited in place, for that reason.

task_type_fields.path: tools/AGENTS.md (directory-scoped agent instructions, plus the hardlinked tools/CLAUDE.md, tools/GEMINI.md, tools/OPENCODE.md and tools/QWEN.md shims)
task_type_fields.proposed_change: Rewrite the last sentence of the 'ToolRun smokes' section from 'Later-phase live owner cases remain labeled phase-pending unless --live is passed.' to state that the three live cases (dod-8-live-monitor, dod-8-live-proc, dod-13-overhead) are labeled not-run unless --live is passed, and that with --live the harness runs all 35 cases.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction by the sase-17p land agent at master 682089c84 (2026-09-24): tools/AGENTS.md 'ToolRun smokes' still ends 'Later-phase live owner cases remain labeled phase-pending unless --live is passed'. The drift has grown: epic sase-17p phase 6 (c91690efc) added tools/_smoke_tool_runs_cases_handoff.py, the E2 hand-off fault-matrix group (hermetic dod-14-handoff-* cases plus live dod-14-live-handoff-{stop,viewers,crash,delivery} and dod-14-live-monitor-handoff, all labeled not-run without --live), which the paragraph does not mention. The rewrite should say live cases are labeled not-run without --live and name the hand-off case group next to catalog/foreground/signals/lost-run/fail-open/query.
